Protect from light. Adverse Effects, Treatment, and Precautions As for Fluorouracil, p.722. Adverse reactions after intra-arterial infusion often include local reactions, thromboembolic compli- cations, and infection or bleeding at the catheter site, or blockage of the catheter. Erythema, stomatitis, and gastrointestinal distur- bances are relatively common. There have also been signs of liv- er dysfunction. Effects on the liver.
